summary: Comprehensive backend + mobile web frontend testing of SubMind. Backend: 18/18 pytest tests passed (100%) — covers /api/ health, ingest text/link/image, subscriptions CRUD + soft delete + payment, duplicate detection, links CRUD, watchlist + convert, reminders, smart inbox + actions, insights, search, knowledge graph, AI chat (returned real answer 'Your monthly spend is **AED 414.97**'), AI compare, settings, and STT endpoint. Link ingest is resilient (saves even on scraping failure). Image ingest returns structured response with 100x100 PNG (Pillow-generated). Frontend: onboarding (3 steps) → home works. All 5 pill-nav tabs (Home/Subs/+/Inbox/AI) navigate correctly. Home hero shows spend AED 414.97/mo across seeded subs. Subs list shows filter chips + seeded subs; tapping card opens detail with status chips + record-payment + delete. Inbox shows All/Needs Review/Auto Added/Duplicates tabs with Merge/Add/Watch/Ignore triage buttons. Ask AI sends question and renders answer bubble. Actions modal shows all 8 actions (Scan Screenshot, Choose Photo, Paste Link, Add Subscription, Add Plan, Add Reminder, Add Note, Ask AI). All 13 shortcut/detail routes render without crashing (link-vault, watchlist, reminders, insights, graph, search, settings, paste-link, add-subscription, add-plan, add-reminder, add-note, scan). No red-screen errors. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) detected. No SafeAreaView-from-react-native imports.
action_items: Optional: Console warnings (non-blocking) from RN Web — 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use boxShadow) and 'props.pointerEvents' deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Only affects web preview; safe to ignore for native builds.
Optional: expo-notifications warns that push token listener is not supported on web — expected; feature only works on native builds.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1070 lines. Consider splitting into routers (subs.py, links.py, inbox.py, ai.py) if it grows further; currently manageable but approaching the 700-line guideline.
AI models FAST_MODEL='gemini-3-flash-preview' and PRO_MODEL='gemini-3.1-pro-preview' — confirm these preview model IDs are still valid in emergentintegrations; extraction currently works fine.
clean() mutates the input doc (pops _id). Fine given usage, but noting for future refactors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (onboarding, home, subs, subs detail, inbox, AI chat, actions modal, and 13 shortcut routes)

seed_data_creation: Tests create then delete their own TEST_ prefixed data. A few residual test inbox items remain (e.g. TEST_DupProv, TEST_InboxItem, Adobe/Netflix 100/95% duplicate matches) as inbox items are only soft-deleted via the ignore action; not harmful.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://subscription-vault-15.preview.emergentagent.com/api. Single-user 'local', no auth. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_submind_api.py — reuse and extend. Frontend uses expo-router with (tabs)/ group; testIDs are set consistently: tab-index/tab-subscriptions/tab-add/tab-inbox/tab-ai, sub-{id}, inbox-{id}, inbox-action-Merge/Add/Watch/Ignore, ai-input/ai-send, action-{Name} in actions modal, onboarding-next, header-back, status-{Active|Trial|...}, record-payment, delete-sub, sub-filter-{status}, quick-{Scan|Paste|Ask AI|Add}, shortcut-{Link Vault|Watchlist|Reminders|Insights|Brain Map}. Onboarding must be cleared each fresh browser context (3 taps of onboarding-next).
